articles.summary: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) today announced American Airlines as the primary airline carrier for its future West Terminal, the airport's first new terminal in nearly 40 years.
articles.title: A bigger future in the Valley: American selected to anchor Phoenix’s new West Terminal

articles.summary: American Airlines Group Inc. (NASDAQ: AAL) CEO Robert Isom and CFO Devon May will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference on Sept. 16 at 7:45 a.m. PT.
articles.title: American Airlines to webcast remarks at Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference

articles.summary: On Aug. 31, 43 team members from across American and its three wholly owned regional carriers were recognized as 2026 Safety Champions during a celebration dinner at the airline’s Robert L. Crandall Campus in Fort Worth, Texas.
articles.title: Celebrating safety excellence: Meet American's team members who go above and beyond
